The visible sequence supports degrés. No separate initial i or i-dot appears before the d-shaped form, and the central descender does not support classes. The surrounding heading reads Inégalités de convexité et ... remarquables d'opérateurs compacts. Inspected the full scan and crops/1_scan082_L1570_heading.jpg, crops/1_scan082_L1570_word.jpg, and crops/1_scan082_L1570_word_detail.jpg.
